properties.description: The valid download types are: Type Description bt bittorrent download nzb newsgroup download http HTTP download ftp FTP download

The valid download status are: Status Description stopped task is stopped, can be resumed by setting the status to downloading queued task will start when a new download slot is available the queue position is stored in queue_pos attribute starting task is preparing to start download downloading stopping task is gracefully stopping error there was a problem with the download, you can get an error code in the error field done the download is over. For bt you can resume seeding setting the status to seeding if the ratio is not reached yet checking (only valid for nzb) download is over, the downloaded files are being checked using par2 repairing (only valid for nzb) download is over, the downloaded files are being repaired using par2 extracting (only valid for nzb) download is over, the downloaded files are being extracted seeding (only valid for bt) download is over, the content is Change to being shared to other users. The task will automatically stop once the seed ratio has been reached retry You can set a task status to ‘retry’ to restart the download task.
position in download queue (0 if not queued)
The valid download priorities are: Priority Description low low normal normal high high
transmit percentage (without protocol overhead) To improve precision the value as been scaled by 100 so that a tx_pct of 123 means 1.23%
received percentage (without protocol overhead) To improve precision the value as been scaled by 100 so that a tx_pct of 123 means 1.23%
timestamp of the download creation time
directory where the file(s) will be saved (base64 encoded)

Only relevant for bittorrent tasks. Once the transmit ration has been reached the task will stop seeding. The ratio is scaled by 100 to improve resolution. A stop_ratio of 150 means that the task will stop seeding once tx_bytes = 1.5 * rx_bytes.
( only relevant for nzb ) password for extracting downloaded archives
( only relevant for bt ) torrent info_hash encoded in hexa
( only relevant for bt ) torrent piece length in bytes
The valid config status are: Type Description not_checked config has not been checked yet checking test in progress error config is invalid, see error ok config is ok

The valid config status are: Type Description none test is ok nzb_authentication_required authentication is required bad_authentication incorrect credentials connection_refused unable to connect to NNTP server
is the dht enabled on IPv6
number of active nodes on IPv6
number of active tasks (checking + queued + extracting + repairing + seeding + downloading)
current receive rate in bytes / second
current transmit rate in bytes / second
if true, the current throttling mode has been computed using the throttling schedule if false, the current throttling mode has been manually forced
full filepath on the disk (encoded as in file system api)
file download status Status Description queued file is queued for download error there was a problem with this file, see error to get the error code done file download is completed
file error code in case status is error
file download priority inside the download task Priority Description no_dl this file will not be downloaded low low priority normal default priority high high priority
url to preview downloaded file (only available for bittorrent) as a share link, this url can be use without requiring any form of authentication so that it can be passed as-is to any software.
true if the tracker is a backup tracker (the downloader won’t connect to this tracker unless the primary tracker fails)
tracker status Status Description unannounced not announced announcing announcing announce_failed an error occurred while trying to announce announced announced
desired interval between two announces (in seconds)
minimum interval between two announces (in seconds)
number of seeders announced on tracker
number of leechers announced on tracker
peer state State Description disconnected not connected connecting trying to connect to the peer handshaking connected to the peer, negotiating capabilities ready ready to exchange data
peer origin Origin Description tracker got the peer from the tracker incoming incoming peer dht got the peer from DHT pex got the peer from Peer exchange protocol user manually added peer
Protocol Description tcp TCP tcp_obfuscated Obfuscated TCP udp UDP
Peer country code (iso 3166) If country code is not available it will have the value “??”
